title: Pyne Pod Pink Purple Lemonade Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pyne Pod NicSalts Pink Purple Lemonade 10ml E-Liquid offers a vibrant and deeply complex beverage-inspired vape. The profile is anchored by a sharp, zesty Lemonade base that provides a bright and sparkling inhale. This is elevated by a rich, syrupy blend of sweet Red Fruits and dark, succulent Purple Grapes, creating a multi-layered finish that perfectly balances citrus brightness with deep, fruit-forward sweetness. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Pyne Pod Nic Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Pyne Pod Nic Salts collection translates the intense, highly popular flavours of their renowned prefilled pods into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the layered zest of Pink Purple Lemonade, vapers can explore other irresistible blends such as the rich Strawberry Cherry, the classic Blueberry Raspberry, or the tropical Fruit Punch.
